claims: The Hunt for Gollum is an upcoming live-action film.
The Hunt for Gollum is directed by Andy Serkis.
The Hunt for Gollum is scheduled for release on December 17, 2027.
The Hunt for Gollum explores Aragorn's quest to find Gollum between The Hobbit and The Fellowship of the Ring.
The Hunt for Gollum takes place in the 17-year gap between Bilbo’s 111th birthday party and Frodo leaving the Shire.
The 17-year gap is a period when Gandalf fears Gollum might reveal information about the One Ring to Sauron.
Aragorn (Strider) is tasked by Gandalf to track down Gollum through the dangerous corners of Middle-earth.
The Hunt for Gollum explores Gollum's backstory.
The Hunt for Gollum explores Gollum's time in Mordor.
The Hunt for Gollum explores Gollum's capture.
The Hunt for Gollum is expected to feature appearances from other original cast members.
The Hunt for Gollum is scheduled to begin in 2026.
Warner Bros. produces The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum.
The Hunt for Gollum have not been publicly announced as of early 2026.
